text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Mirako-chan, it's finally... It's finally 
today!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Phew... Is this really okay? My heart's 
starting to... race a little...!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
It's totally fine! A cake shop by a 
world-famous pastry chef... Let's just go 
for it!!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Waaah! We're really going~! I've had my 
eye on that raspberry cake with all the 
layers of mousse and chocolate~!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
The seasonal sakura cake is super cute, 
too~! But... ugh, th-the price...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Is this really okay?! Isn't this a bit too 
extravagant...？！

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: It's totally fine! Because today is—

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text:
Because it's my...—birthday! It's 
Mirako-chan's birthday, after all!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Wheeew, totally, right?! It's only once a 
year, so let's indulge ourselves~! We'll 
order the premium tea, too, and keep it 
classy!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Anyway, thanks for coming along with me, 
Top Road-chan! I was too scared to go 
alone~!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Same to you! Let's make this a luxurious 
and wonderful birthday!
